title: A new organization created after the release starts on Due on Receipt
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • An organization {Organization-A} created after the release, never changed on the Credit Terms page, and you are its Admin.
    For example: {Organization-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-10 Shop.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Name column.
  2. Open the Customers page.
  3. Click "New Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Due on Receipt carries the "Default" tag.
  • Step 2: the page opens.
  • Step 3: Credit Terms is prefilled with Due on Receipt (Default).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R12: “An organization created after release starts with Due on Receipt as its default.”
  • Key Decisions: “Existing organizations keep COD as their default at release; organizations created after release start on Due on Receipt. No existing customer changes term.”
  • Goals: “With no setup at all, existing shops behave exactly as before release (default COD, the same twelve terms), and new shops start on Due on Receipt.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
